rule: Erase the magenta marker (a T or an asymmetric cross). Rotate its long-arm direction 90 degrees CCW in image coordinates, (dy,dx)->(-dx,dy), to get the mirror direction: stem-down->right, long-left->down, long-right->up, stem-up->left. Stamp the reflection of the yellow figure's tight bounding box flush against that box on that side. The copy may overwrite former marker cells.
scope: Chiral T/cross marker selects an adjacent reflection of a tight yellow figure. Random grids support 6..30 per side; sampled figure extents grow to fit the duplicated canvas. Both-axis asymmetry distinguishes reflection from translation and half-turn rotation. Explicit fixture-compatible patterns may be thin or symmetric about the perpendicular axis.
constraints: Six canonical pairs reconstructed exactly; 1000 independent seeds agree with the archived solver.

Random default size sampling favours smaller grids; the episode builder must request larger dimensions to meet corpus size targets.
Axis feasibility checks reject basic impossibilities immediately; remaining spatial conflicts use at most 300 attempts. Explicit patterns need not reject a 180-degree-rotation shortcut.

authored_scope: Colours 0/4/6 are fixed. Random grids are 6..30 per side, mostly 6..16. Sampled figure extents grow with the canvas, up to half the canvas along the mirror axis and the full canvas across it, with 30% small extents. Density is capped so yellow stays below 1/4 of the grid. Sampled figures are random fills (exact box, often multi-piece) or grown 8-connected blobs, asymmetric about both axes. Explicit patterns only need a tight box, >=3 cells and mirror-axis asymmetry; they may be 1-thin and any size that fits, which keeps the fixtures compatible. All 8 marker orientations are sampled; 4 are synthetic by rotation equivariance (chiral, never reflected). Partial controls condition sizes, extents and positions on feasibility. Not supported: other colours, non-zero background, multiple markers, figures that touch the marker, or copies that leave the grid.
authored_constraints: Exactly one magenta marker, taken from the 8 rotation-defined shapes; marker box disjoint from the figure box; no magenta cell 8-adjacent to yellow.
Figure pattern is a tight box with >=3 cells and is asymmetric about the mirror axis. Sampled patterns are also asymmetric about the other axis, so reflect != translate and reflect != rotate180.
Figure start lies in the range where the reflected copy fits entirely inside the grid.
0 is strictly the most common colour in input and output (yellow < 1/4 of cells after duplication).

Explicit coordinates are validated immediately (0..29 and inside any given size). Kind/arm membership is type-checked, so unhashable values raise ValueError. Infeasible control combinations are rejected before sampling.
Grid sizes are within 1..30; the output has the same size as the input.
